name: Chickpea Spinach Curry
steps: Heat oil and sauté onion, garlic, and ginger until soft.
Add curry powder and cook for 30 seconds.
Stir in diced tomatoes and simmer for 5 minutes.
Add chickpeas and coconut milk, then simmer for 10 minutes.
Fold in spinach and cook until wilted.
Season with salt and pepper and serve.

name: Greek Yogurt Berry Oats
steps: Combine oats, milk, yogurt, and chia seeds in a jar.
Stir well and refrigerate overnight.
Top with mixed berries and honey before serving.

name: Lemon Herb Chicken Quinoa Bowl
steps: Cook quinoa according to package instructions.
Season chicken with garlic, salt, pepper, and lemon juice.
Pan-sear chicken until cooked through, then slice.
Mix cucumber, tomatoes, parsley, olive oil, and lemon juice.
Serve sliced chicken over quinoa with the salad on top.

name: Tofu Veggie Stir-Fry
steps: Cook rice and set aside.
Cube tofu, coat lightly with cornstarch, and pan-fry until golden.
Sauté garlic and ginger in sesame oil.
Add broccoli, bell pepper, and carrot and stir-fry until crisp-tender.
Return tofu to the pan, add soy sauce, and toss well.
Serve stir-fry over rice.

name: Turkey Lettuce Wraps
steps: Heat oil and sauté onion and garlic.
Add ground turkey and cook until browned.
Stir in soy sauce and shredded carrot and cook for 2 minutes.
Spoon filling into lettuce leaves.
Top with sliced green onion and black pepper.

name: Black Bean Sweet Potato Tacos
steps: Dice sweet potato and roast with oil, cumin, chili powder, and salt until tender.
Warm black beans in a small pan.
Heat corn tortillas.
Fill tortillas with sweet potato and black beans.
Top with red onion, avocado, and lime juice.

name: Paneer Pea Masala
steps: Sauté onion, garlic, and ginger in oil until soft.
Add cumin and garam masala and cook briefly.
Stir in diced tomatoes and simmer for 5 minutes.
Add peas and paneer cubes and cook for 8 minutes.
Season with salt and serve hot.

name: Baked Salmon with Asparagus
steps: Preheat oven to 425F.
Place salmon and asparagus on a sheet pan.
Drizzle with olive oil, lemon juice, and minced garlic.
Season with salt and pepper.
Bake until salmon flakes easily and asparagus is tender.

name: Egg Fried Cauliflower Rice
steps: Scramble eggs in a pan and set aside.
Sauté garlic, peas, and carrot in sesame oil for 2 minutes.
Add cauliflower rice and cook until tender.
Stir in soy sauce and cooked eggs.
Top with sliced green onion before serving.

name: Lentil Vegetable Soup
steps: Sauté onion, carrot, celery, and garlic in olive oil.
Add lentils, diced tomatoes, broth, and thyme.
Bring to a boil, then simmer until lentils are tender.
Season with salt and pepper and serve.

name: Chicken Fajita Bowl
steps: Cook brown rice and set aside.
Season chicken with chili powder, cumin, salt, and pepper.
Cook chicken in a skillet until done, then slice.
Sauté bell pepper and onion until soft.
Serve chicken and vegetables over rice with lime juice.

name: Caprese Pasta Salad
steps: Cook pasta, drain, and cool.
Combine pasta with cherry tomatoes and mozzarella.
Add basil, olive oil, and balsamic vinegar.
Season with salt and pepper and toss well.

name: Beef and Broccoli Stir-Fry
steps: Cook rice and set aside.
Slice beef and toss with cornstarch.
Sear beef in sesame oil until browned, then remove.
Stir-fry broccoli, garlic, and ginger until tender-crisp.
Return beef to pan, add soy sauce, and cook for 2 minutes.
Serve over rice.

name: Avocado Egg Toast
steps: Toast the bread slices.
Mash avocado with lemon juice, salt, and pepper.
Cook eggs to your preference.
Spread avocado on toast and top with eggs.
Finish with chili flakes.

name: Zucchini Noodle Pesto Chicken
steps: Season and cook chicken breast in olive oil until done, then slice.
Sauté garlic briefly in the same pan.
Add zucchini noodles and cook for 2 to 3 minutes.
Stir in pesto and cherry tomatoes.
Top with sliced chicken and serve.

name: Mediterranean Chickpea Salad
steps: Rinse and drain chickpeas.
Chop cucumber, tomatoes, onion, and parsley.
Whisk lemon juice, olive oil, salt, and pepper.
Combine everything in a bowl and toss well.

name: Shrimp Garlic Rice Skillet
steps: Cook rice and set aside.
Sauté onion and garlic in olive oil.
Add shrimp, paprika, salt, and pepper and cook until pink.
Stir in peas and cooked rice.
Finish with lemon juice and serve.

name: Mushroom Spinach Omelette
steps: Whisk eggs with salt and pepper.
Sauté onion and mushrooms in olive oil.
Add spinach and cook until wilted.
Pour in eggs and cook until set.
Fold omelette and serve warm.
